lede: The week's heaviest lift is Wednesday, when the BOCC sits as the Housing Authority to dig into regional affordable housing compliance at a moment when those finances are genuinely stressed, Ouray County holds three public hearings including a full repeal of a land-use code section, and Mountain Village Council considers a resolution that sets the appreciation cap on deed-restricted units — the fine print that decides whether affordable housing actually stays affordable. HARC tackles the Shandoka Lot redevelopment on Black Bear Road across two preliminary hearings, P&Z gets its first look at school district employee housing on the TMHS site, and Tuesday marks the first day of school for Telluride R-1.
